description:
SO MANY OF YOU are procrastinating shit you CARE ABOUT

because you compulsively do everything for everyone else all the time even when they have not asked you to

Or do not need you to

And then you burn out and become resentful bc of unnecessary things
transcript: Every single one of the most helpful people I know is also secretly resentful of all the shit they do for other people all the time. And if that's you, I have a hack as a younger brother that's gonna teach you how to be lazy like your younger siblings. From now on, whenever you feel you have to go do another thing when you're already exhausted, go through this checklist instead. Did anyone ask me to do it? If no, don't do it. If yes, will there be any consequences other than someone being upset with me? If no, don't do it. If yes, did they ask me to do it compulsorily? If no, don't do it. If yes, do they have the authority to make me do something? If no, don't do it. If yes, did they ask me to do it in the absolute best possible way? If no, do it in a just good enough way if you say yes to every single question then you're allowed to do it in the best possible way otherwise say no if you have bandwidth you're allowed to be helpful if you're exhausted overwhelmed and busy use the checklist love you thank you for buying us things
